description: This file defines a Java interface named ExecQueryCallbackFunctionIF used for executing callback functions during SQL query processing, specifically for processing each row of a ResultSet.

classes.name: ExecQueryCallbackFunctionIF
classes.description: A Java interface for defining callback functions to process rows in an SQL ResultSet.

methods.name: processNextRow
methods.description: Processes the next row in the ResultSet, returning true if there is a next row to process and false otherwise. May throw SQLException.
